rule: Cloud '/code-review ultra' is FORBIDDEN on these repos (they embed confidential deal figures, public-site content under the never-touch guardrail, or tenant PII + secrets). Default review everywhere = superpowers:requesting-code-review (LOCAL subagent). Maintain alongside hooks/confidential-terms.json.

notes.ora-claude-config: Added 2026-08-16 (Gabriel). The ~/.claude backup repo, and the largest PII surface of the five: it tracks the whole memory corpus (316 .md files) -- people.md (counsel/title/broker/lender names), firm.md (AUM, portfolio, entities), deal-decision-ledger.md, disposition-ledger.md, and named tenant-default/delinquency records. Deal TERMS are scrubbed before commit per CLAUDE.md, so the exposure is the corpus, not the confidential-deal roster. It was unlisted until 2026-08-16 while 'ultra' was already forbidden on four less sensitive repos -- found while evaluating AI-review vendors, not by any guard, so do not assume an omission here means 'deliberately excluded'.
notes.coderabbit_exception: DELIBERATE, Gabriel-ratified 2026-08-16: the CodeRabbit GitHub App keeps read access to ora-claude-config despite the listing above. Scope note -- this list governs '/code-review ultra' only; it has never gated third-party GitHub Apps, which are installed out-of-band and are NOT blocked by anything in this file or in hooks/. If that access is ever withdrawn, remove this note. CodeRabbit's free tier is public-repos-only, so on this private repo it yields ~1 review before rate-limiting; it is not a dependable gate and must not be treated as one.
